name: Admin Diagnostic Analytics Dashboard
description: Admin reviews full analytics parity with proposal analytics tab: engagement score (0–100 color-coded), summary KPIs (total views, unique sessions, first view, reading time, coverage, last visit), comparison with global averages, funnel with drop-off %, device breakdown (desktop/mobile/tablet), suggested actions, skipped sections, section heatmap, engagement table, activity timeline, sessions history, and CSV export button. Data sourced from DiagnosticViewEvent + DiagnosticSectionView + DiagnosticChangeLog.
